svg.aria-label: Dive into my code. Many tools, one calm workflow. Things I have built.
Animated koi pond banner: Dive into my code.

svg.text: Every letter on this page is built from the tools
I use every day — React, Python, Spring, PyTorch,
Docker and more. Code is how I build things,
and these are my building blocks.
Real interfaces from real projects — designed, coded and shipped,
one screen at a time. Infinitely.
